linkedin: Collectors know the feeling: you're at an estate sale, a charity shop, or a record fair—and you spot it. That book. That album. You're 90% sure you already own it, but you're not certain. So you buy it anyway. Later at home, you confirm the worst: duplicate number seven this month. Sound familiar? Serious collectors—whether managing 300 books, 500 vinyl records, or a mixed library—deserve better than cloud subscriptions, mandatory accounts, or apps that track your data. SeniorEase solves this with radical simplicity: scan the barcode on your phone (€4.99, one time), and your collection stays private on your device. No internet required. No passwords. No monthly fees. Just a straightforward tool built for people who respect their collections—and their time. If you've ever bought a duplicate, you know why this matters. Learn more at seniorease.eu. #Collecting #Privacy #SmartTools
